boardObjectives.label: Spend £35m or more on one signing
Have 7 players from England in the squad

inbox.text: International break: the window runs 5 Sep to 13 Sep, and your fixtures do not stop for it, so they went straight after your last game. Away with their countries (Ghana: Michael Essien; England: Frank Lampard, Shaun Wright-Phillips, John Terry, Joe Cole, Wayne Bridge and Glen Johnson; Cote d'Ivoire: Didier Drogba; Netherlands: Arjen Robben; Portugal: Ricardo Carvalho, Paulo Ferreira and Filipe Oliveira; Czech Republic: Petr Cech and Jiri Jarosik; Ireland: Damien Duff; Argentina: Hernán Crespo; Spain: Asier del Horno; France: Claude Makélélé and William Gallas; Iceland: Eidur Gudjohnsen; Cameroon: Njitap Geremi; Finland: Mikael Forssell; Russia: Aleksey Smertin). They are back for the West Brom game. Michael Essien, Frank Lampard, Shaun Wright-Phillips, Didier Drogba, Arjen Robben, John Terry, Petr Cech, Damien Duff, Paulo Ferreira, Hernán Crespo, Asier del Horno, Claude Makélélé, Jiri Jarosik, William Gallas, Eidur Gudjohnsen, Njitap Geremi, Mikael Forssell, Aleksey Smertin and Filipe Oliveira started for their countries, the rest mostly watched from the bench. The long trips hurt most. Your assistant wants to know: start them against West Brom, or rest the spent ones for that one game?

options.label: Rest the ones who are spent

inbox.resolved: That game has been and gone.

inbox.text: One of your midfielders rated his own performance 10 out of 10 in the club app after a 4-0 defeat.

options.label: Make him explain it to the squad

inbox.text: An agent has been in touch about Shaun Wright-Phillips, who is 23 and has a year left. The desk prices a new deal at £7.7m up front on 43k a week for 4 years. Say nothing and he can talk to anyone in the summer.
Damien Duff has asked for a meeting about his place in the side. He is training well and he does not think the teamsheet reflects it.

pending.text: Paulo Ferreira has started 0 of the last 8. Is he finished at this club?

options.label: He is still my player
options.line: You backed him in front of everybody. He will run through a wall on Saturday.

options.label: He has to earn it back
options.line: Standards, in public. Ten of them heard it as a warning and one heard it as a demotion.

options.label: You would have to ask him
options.line: A shrug and a next question. He was not wounded by it and nobody else was impressed either.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: The squad's fines kitty has £100k in it from late arrivals and phones in meetings. The head coach asks where it should go. The local paper always runs it when it goes to charity.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: The board have £200k spare this quarter and want to know where you want it. They will put it in the transfer pot if you ask, and they would read holding it back as a careful manager.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
